'''Shaultra Loraweet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Shaultra Loraweet]]
Shaultra Loraweet was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Shaultra Loraweet changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Loraweet. However, the quest dialogue given by [[Indintra Imbru Yerevan]] indicated that Shaultra Loraweet was a [[Gender/Legends|female]].
